consequence.statement: Temporary packet drops may occur for connections allowed by toFQDNs policies during the initial endpoint regeneration on Cilium v1.16 when upgrading from a version older than v1.15.6.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade to Cilium v1.15.6 or newer before upgrading to v1.16.

original.statement: Upgrading to Cilium 1.16 from a version older than 1.15.6 with toFQDNs policies may cause temporary packet drops during initial endpoint regeneration; run v1.15.6 or newer first.

decision.reason: [ev-25984c3785d4] says that upgrading to v1.16 from a Cilium version older than v1.15.6 may cause temporary packet drops for connections allowed by `toFQDNs` policies during the initial endpoint regeneration. It also says that running v1.15.6 or newer first is required to avoid those drops. If the operator does nothing, connections in running workloads are dropped, so workload-failure (mandatory work) fits. The proposed statement, the remediation (run v1.15.6+ first) and the medium severity for temporary drops all match that text. Cilium migrates its internal state automatically, so the operator's only step is the intermediate upgrade, which is already captured as the remediation.
